Remarks

A hand being "ready" means that there is one tile remaining to make a valid complete hand of 14 tiles. This means either four Melds of 3 tiles each and a Pair (standard readiness) or one of the special hand patterns of seven pairs/thirteen orphans. Note that a hand may be valid and complete but lack yaku, and thus not be a hand that a player can go out on.

For ease of calculation, all the readiness functions expect a BlockSet, so that it can use the semantic knowledge contained in the derived classes of Block (like Meld and Wait). Given an IEnumerable<T>, use GetPossibleBlockSets(IEnumerable<Tile>) to then feed the possible BlockSets into these functions.

Methods

IsPastReady(BlockSet, out Type)

Returns whether the current hand is past ready, that is, having a hand with more than enough tiles to be ready. It also returns the readiness algorithm used for calculation.

public static bool IsPastReady(this BlockSet hand, out Readiness.Type chosenReadinessType)

Parameters

hand BlockSet

The hand to analyze as a BlockSet.

chosenReadinessType Readiness.Type

Will contain a Readiness.Type indicating the readiness algorithm used after returning.

Returns

bool

true, if the hand is ready, false otherwise.

Remarks

Note that this may or may not be the same as a "valid complete" hand. This function does not consider if all Blocks in the BlockSet are not a Wait or Orphan, nor that there are only 14 tiles.

SevenPairsTilesToReady(BlockSet)

Returns the number of tiles that the hand must take in to be ready, using the seven pairs readiness calculation algorithm, which assumes the valid complete hand will be made up of seven Pairs.

public static int SevenPairsTilesToReady(BlockSet hand)

Parameters

hand BlockSet

The hand to analyze as a BlockSet.

Returns

int

The number of tiles remaining until a ready hand based on the seven pairs algorithm.

Remarks

Note that in certain cases, non-positive numbers like zero and below are valid results, representing a "past-ready" hand (see IsPastReady(BlockSet, out Type)).

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

Thrown when given a BlockSet that does NOT contain only a single SevenPairsWait, as such hands cannot be correctly calculated using the seven pairs algorithm. Note that this includes hands that have multiple SevenPairsWaits.

StandardTilesToReady(BlockSet)

Returns the number of tiles that the hand must take in to be ready, using the standard readiness calculation algorithm, which assumes the valid complete hand will be made up of four Melds of 3 tiles, and a Pair.

public static int StandardTilesToReady(BlockSet hand)

Parameters

hand BlockSet

The hand to analyze as a BlockSet.

Returns

int

The number of tiles remaining until a ready hand based on the standard algorithm.

Remarks

Note that in certain cases, non-positive numbers like zero and below are valid results, representing a "past-ready" hand (see IsPastReady(BlockSet, out Type)).

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

Thrown when given a BlockSet that contains a SevenPairsWait or ThirteenOrphansWait, as these hands cannot be correctly calculated using the standard algorithm.

ThirteenOrphansTilesToReady(BlockSet)

Returns the number of tiles that the hand must take in to be ready, using the thirteen orphans readiness calculation algorithm, which assumes the valid complete hand will be made up of twelve distinct terminal and Zi suit Orphans, and the last remaining distinct terminal/Zi suit in a Pair.
